subject: Org simplification: proposed role consolidations, OKR alignment, and QBR talking points
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -0000
Subject: Org simplification - proposed role consolidations & comms

Team —

Attached is an initial draft for an executive-facing comms and a proposed roll plan to simplify a couple of overlapping manager roles in Platform & Growth. High level: consolidate two product manager lead roles into a single cross-functional product lead, reassign one people manager to Platform Ops, and create a short-term IC growth hire to cover funnel ownership during the transition.

Why now (brief):
- Reduces manager-to-IC span overlap across Platform and Growth.
- Aligns with Q2 OKR updates (drive faster shipping cadence).
- Lowers monthly people costs by ~1.2 FTE run rate while keeping capacity for key initiatives.

What I need from you by EOD 28 Mar:
1) Feedback on the comms wording (tone + risks).
2) Confirmation that the transition timeline (2–4 weeks) is operationally feasible for your squads.
3) Any regulatory/compliance or procurement flags we should raise to Legal/People now.

Attachment: Org_Simplify_Comm_Draft_v1.docx (draft comms + timeline table)

If there's no major objection, I'll fold feedback and circulate a canary communication to the four affected managers and set a short QBR talking points section for execs.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Org simplification - proposed role consolidations & comms

Thanks Sean — quick inline thoughts below. 

On Mon, 22 Mar 2027 at 09:30, Sean Gallagher wrote:
> Attached is an initial draft for an executive-facing comms and a proposed roll plan to simplify a couple of overlapping manager roles in Platform & Growth.

High level: I support the simplification but have two concerns:
- Canary approach: prefer we pilot with one team to limit disruption (suggested: Platform Scheduler team).
- Timing vs hiring: we have two open IC reqs that haven't closed; losing both managers simultaneously will create a coverage gap. Suggest phasing over 6 weeks, not 2.

Tone edits: replace "cost savings" language with "efficiency and clarity of ownership" (less HR/finance-forward).

Also flagging Legal and People — I'll loop in Jenna (People) and Ravi (Legal) once we have a version for broad distribution.

Attachment: redlines_Org_Simplify_v1.docx (tracked changes + alternative timeline)

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Org simplification - proposed role consolidations & comms

Appreciate the draft. Short OKR check in re: impact if we shift timeline to Laura's 6-week phased approach:
- OKR: "Decrease time-to-ship for platform features" — target remains 15% velocity improvement by EOY.
- Risk: a 6-week phase increases near-term risk to velocity by ~4–6% while hires are open. However, if we hold the IC reqs in parallel we can mitigate.

Proposed compromise: proceed with canary in Scheduler team (2 weeks), pause next consolidation until we close 1 of the two open ICs. That buys runway for QBR reporting while limiting disruption.

One-line reply from Evelyn: "+1 to canary + pause for second consolidation until hire closes."

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Engineering Ops

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 16:40:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Org simplification - proposed role consolidations & comms

Thanks all — leaning into the compromise. Plan update: 
- Canary: run Scheduler team consolidation over two weeks starting 5 Apr; keep the second consolidation on hold until we fill the first open IC req.
- Comms: updated tone per Laura's note; removed explicit cost language.
- QBR: I added a 10-minute slot in the exec QBR to surface the pilot, expected metrics, and fallback plan. See attached deck for slides.

Action items: 
- Marissa: pull two talking points for exec QBR (pilot goals + mitigation).
- Laura: loop Jenna (People) and Ravi (Legal) on the revised comms draft.
- Karthik: confirm coverage plan for the 2-week pilot.

Attachment: QBR_ExecDeck_v2.pdf (exec slides + one-slide pilot plan)

I'll draft the canary message to the two affected managers Friday 1 Apr unless I hear objections.

—Sean
